Name: Amon, Governor of the City
Summary: Amon, governor of the city, was ordered by Ahab to hold Micaiah in prison on bread and water of affliction until the king returned in peace.
KeyStory: Ahab commanded that Micaiah be carried back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king's son, and put in prison.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Micaiah, Son of Imla
LifeLesson: Carrying out an unjust order is still a share in the injustice.
